data.one_liner: Record MP3 files on Android, iOS, and macOS using native platform APIs
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets you start, pause, resume, and stop MP3 recordings. It exports the recording as an MP3 file that can be saved or shared.
use_when: You need to record audio in MP3 format for offline use
You want native performance without relying on external libraries
You need support for 16k audio on Android 15+
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS simulators without headphone support
You need to run on Intel x86_64 Android emulators
strengths: Native API usage gives low latency and high quality
Cross‑platform support for Android, iOS, and macOS
weaknesses: Simulator and Intel x86_64 emulator limitations
data.setup_notes: Add microphone permission in AndroidManifest and iOS Info.plist. For macOS, modify Podfile to exclude x86_64 and add permission handler PR. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic audio recording on Android and iOS, but not MP3 specific
